decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - In the absence of sufficient detail to demonstrate how 10% of the predicted energy requirements of the housing scheme can be met on site by the proposed biomass boiler, it is considered that the proposal fails to adequately conserve resources and energy, contrary to policy SD9 (Resources and energy) of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006.
Reason : 2 - The proposed cycle storage areas at basement level, by reason of their location inaccessible by a lift or ramp, would provide an unacceptable standard of storage, contrary to policy T3 (Pedestrians and cycling) of the London Borough of Camden Replacement Unitary Development Plan 2006 and supporting advice contained within the Camden Planning Guidance 2006. 
Reason : 3 - In the absence of a legal agreement to ensure an EcoHomes rating of 'Very Good' or 'Excellent' would be achieved, the proposed development would fail to adequately conserve resources and energy, contrary to policies SD2 and SD9 and B1 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2006 and guidance contained within Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
Reason : 4 - In the absence of a legal agreement to secure an education contribution, the proposed development would be likely to contribute unacceptably to pressure on the Borough's education provision,contrary to policy SD2 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2006 and guidance contained within Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
Reason : 5 - In the absence of a legal agreement to secure an open space contribution, the proposed development would be likely to contribute unacceptably to pressure on the Borough's open space provision, contrary to policies SD2 and N4 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2006 and guidance contained within Camden Planning Guidance 2006.
Reason : 6 - In the absence of a legal agreement to secure car-free housing, the proposed development would be likely to result in increased parking stress and congestion in the locality to the detriment of highway and pedestrian safety, contrary to policies T8 and T9 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2006.
description: Change of use of ground and basement floors from retail (Class A1) to ten residential units (3 x studio flats, 5 x 1 bedroom, 1 x 2 bedroom and 1 x 3 bedroom flats) on ground and basement levels with associated external alterations to provide new windows, glazing and railings to the front elevation at ground floor, new lightwell at front basement level and erection of two new 2-storey flat roof extensions to the rear.
